findings: GetHash returns path-keyed cached Image without observing current content or metadata; stale path reuse is possible. Static only.

Channel send/receive operations use blocking operations inside select default branch, outside ctx cancellation alternatives; stopped consumers can prevent cancellation. No deadlock execution performed.
Pair cache concatenates filenames with a space, which is ambiguous for paths containing spaces; typed tuple identities are preferable. Static only.

decision: Reference only; no code adoption. Keep rrrah content-bound cache recipes, typed pair identities, explicit decode dispatch and cancellable bounded work.
